text: This report responds to the Planning and Housing Committee's request to bring forward an aggressive and targeted strategy for supportive and transitional housing in Toronto. Since February 2019 City staff have been working closely with the Toronto Alliance to End Homelessness (TAEH) and members of the supportive and transitional housing sector to discuss options to address the shortage of supportive housing in Toronto. On June 5th, 2019 the City and TAEH jointly hosted a supportive charrette to discuss options to how to remove barriers to increase supportive housing in the City. A pre-event survey was sent to ask supportive housing providers to identify short, medium and long-term opportunities to increase supportive housing in the City.
